claims.object_text: rare pathogenic variant identified in patients with psychosis of epilepsy
claims.quote: Twenty-nine percent of the patients with POE with genetic data had a rare pathogenic variant: 19 in an epilepsy gene (PCDH19, SCN1A, DEPDC5, KCNT1, CHD2, SLC2A1, NPRL3, CLN3, NPRL3, ATP1A3, and CACNA1A) and 4 had a chromosomal anomaly.
